answer: Unrepeatable Answer Challenge. Each new identity must answer a fresh challenge derived from the current chain tip, and the answer is bound to one thread of prior interactions that must itself be distinct. A submitter must sign over a hollow digest of their entire answer history, so replaying any past response fails. The beacon value from the latest block seeds the challenge, forcing per-identity work. Attacker cost is one full interaction history plus a unique signed answer per identity, making bulk creation linear and expensive.
